root_idea.summary: The root centers on protection, guarding, and secure enclosure.
root_idea.development: The basic idea of making something inaccessible develops into fortresses and fortified objects, self-protection, and the figurative protection expressed by chastity, marriage, or protected status.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form IV perfect citation form.
Displayed under the singular dictionary form حِصْن, although the Quran occurrence is plural.
Displayed under the singular passive-participial citation form مُحْصَنَة.
Displayed separately from مُحْصَنَة as the Form II passive participle مُحَصَّنَة.
Displayed under the singular active-participial citation form مُحْصِن.
Displayed as the verbal noun تَحَصُّن.

senses.definition: To protect, defend, or secure against access or harm.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic protective use includes protection supplied by a protective object or means.

senses.definition: To preserve or store securely in a fortified place.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of provisions or other things kept safe in places functioning as fortresses.

senses.definition: To preserve from illicit or indecorous sexual conduct; to maintain chastity.
senses.usage_conditions: Applied to preserving the pudendum and, more broadly, to protection from suspicion or sexual impropriety.

senses.definition: To cause to be married; in the passive, to become married.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic occurrence is passive; the same Form IV construction is also explicitly used for marrying or giving a woman in marriage.

senses.definition: In a reported variant Quranic reading, to become Muslim.
senses.usage_conditions: This is a variant interpretation reported in the lexical evidence; no modern verse location is assigned to the historical citation.

senses.definition: A fortress, fort, or fortified place.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic plural denotes fortified places used for protection.

senses.definition: Married; protected by a marriage bond.
senses.usage_conditions: This sense is used of women whose existing marriage protects them from other marital access.
A Quranic social-status use, especially in contrast with enslaved women.

senses.definition: Chaste or continent, abstaining from unlawful sexual conduct.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic contexts may present chastity as the relevant protected status; the form can also overlap contextually with protection through marriage.
Describes a place constructed or strengthened like a fortress.

senses.definition: Maintaining or seeking chastity; abstaining from illicit sexual conduct.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic construction contrasts this protected sexual conduct with promiscuous sexual activity.

senses.definition: Self-protective restraint; in the Quranic use, maintaining chastity.
senses.usage_conditions: The verbal noun denotes taking protection for oneself and, in this occurrence, abstaining from illicit sexual conduct.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become inaccessible, difficult of access, or fortified.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form I intransitive; said of a fortress or place.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a woman, to be continent or chaste, abstaining from what is unlawful or indecorous.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Classical Form I use referring to a woman's protected sexual conduct.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a woman, to be married or to have a husband.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Classical Form I use distinct from the intransitive meaning of being chaste.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a woman, to become pregnant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare Classical use explained figuratively as pregnancy protecting her from intercourse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To preserve or guard a person or thing in an inaccessible place, as in a fortress.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive Form I construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Figuratively, horses regarded as protective strongholds.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A tropical or figurative plural use of the fortress image.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Arms or weapons.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Figurative Classical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The new moon or the moon when called هِلَال.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate lexical use recorded in Classical Arabic.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman regarded as protected through chastity, marriage, emancipation, or becoming Muslim; also one made continent by her husband.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These are broader Classical applications of the feminine epithet and are not all assigned to the Quranic occurrences.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A pearl, especially a large pearl.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Explained figuratively as protected within the shell.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A generous, high-bred, male, or stallion horse; a horse fit to cover.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word is explained through the horse's protective relation to its rider and the guarded use of its seed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Inaccessible, unapproachable, or strongly protected; a building that offers refuge.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival derivative applied to places or fortresses.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A firmly and compactly made coat of mail that resists weapons.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The protective quality is compared with a fortress for the body.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The fox.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic name explained by the fox's skill in protecting itself from harm.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man's wife.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A lexical use of the feminine derivative.

other_classical_meanings.definition: More or most strongly fortified or protected against attack.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A comparative or superlative adjectival use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Wheat that has been stored up.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized passive-participial use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man made continent by marriage, or a married man who has a wife.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Classical masculine usage; it is kept distinct from the Quranic feminine form مُحْصَنَة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In juridical usage, the protected sexual status relevant to certain legal rulings.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: For stoning, the conditions listed include Islam, freedom, sound intellect, maturity, valid marriage, and consummation; in accusation-of-adultery cases, chastity is included among the conditions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a man, to marry or take a wife; in legal usage, to have intercourse within a valid marriage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Classical and juridical Form IV use distinct from the Quranic passive construction meaning to become married.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To fortify oneself, enter a fortress, protect oneself by it, or take it as a dwelling.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form V reflexive use, extended to guarding oneself by any means.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a horse, to become or affect to be a stallion or fit to cover.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Classical use applied to a horse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A lock.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized noun for a securing device.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The iron piece extending upward on a horse's nose and forming part of its bridle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical equestrian term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A basket of the type called زَبِيل.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nominal use; the source notes that the feminine form is not used for this meaning.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Protective effect of chastity is covered in the chastity sense.
Includes a reported Quranic variant and juridical definitions.
General self-protection is included in the broader Form V fortification sense.
The unit contains both the literal fortress sense and a horse metaphor.
Includes Quran-attested marital, free, and chaste uses plus broader Classical applications.
Illustrative phrase and cross-reference adding no separate meaning.
The unit gives the noun's lock meaning.
The unit gives a technical equestrian meaning.
The unit gives the basket meaning and its feminine-form restriction.

cautions: The Quranic senses of مُحْصَنَة and مُحَصَّنَة are kept separate: the former is the Form IV passive participle associated with protected status, while the latter is the Form II passive participle meaning fortified.
A reported variant Quranic reading associated with أَحْصَنَ is preserved without converting Lane's historical citation notation into a modern verse location.
